voiceover_script.text: Across the world, conversations about artificial intelligence are raising a central question: what does it mean for technology to serve people? For championing transparency, ethical governance and global collaboration, we can ensure AI becomes a force for good and not a vector for harm.

Across the AI4IA conversations, Ethic Governance is presented not as an abstraction, but as a challenge with concrete human consequences — for people who depend on these systems to work, and work fairly.
But the arrival of AI in Ethic Governance does not resolve the underlying tensions. It often sharpens them — exposing who has voice, who has access, and who bears the risks.
